pillar1Desc: Type naturally in Kurdish Sorani, Arabic, or English. Bazary Gawra extracts product types, city locations, and price limits effortlessly.
pillar2Desc: We highlight what vendors state and what is omitted — missing warranties, return policies, or specifications are flagged clearly.
pillar3Desc: Accurate IQD pricing and neighborhood inventory across Sulaymaniyah (Salim St, Mawlawi), Erbil (Gulan, Ankawa), and Duhok.
pillar4Desc: No fake reviews or inflated 5-star ratings. Products are compared based on verifiable technical specs and seller commitments.

trustDisclaimer: Bazary Gawra does not endorse or certify sellers without physical inspection. Instead, we highlight available versus omitted information so you can make informed decisions.
